text:
ana: Quick prod update — rolled the 'granule-batcher' + 'predictive-kv' combo to the text-gen canary (10% traffic). Early numbers: token cost ~-12%, p95 latency ~-18%, p50 ~+10%.

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/serve@granule-batcher+predictive-kv -> canary (cluster: prod-gen-canary)

sre-bot: canary healthchecks: 5m OK, CPU stable, 1 pod restarted (OOM) — investigating

mike: awesome! which routes/models are in the canary?

ana: applied to light/med seq generation routes only: redwood-7b, rw-13b-quant, and the small-chat stack. Not touching long-seq heavy traffic yet.

olivia: nice win. curious about tail behavior — any change to p99 or error rates?

ana: p99 is flat overall; tiny p99 increase (+4ms) for sequences >1024 tokens. Mitigation: fallback for seq>2048 to legacy packer path (in canary config).

mike: rough $ estimate for hosted spend?

ana: extrapolating current mix -> ~9% net monthly savings at 100% rollout. With batching density tweaks (next PR) we can squeeze ~2-3% more.

olivia: can you paste config so I can repro locally?

ana: local repro: ./dev/run_infer.sh --model redwood-7b --seq 512 --qps 5 with overrides:

```
batcher.granule.max_size=48
batcher.granule.target_fill=0.82
kv.predictive.prefetch_ratio=0.6
fallback.seq_threshold=2048
```

ana: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/1829 — contains benchmarks + flamegraphs.

sre-bot: incident note — pod OOM on startup due to aggressive slot allocation + a 48->64 bump on one machine. Pod auto-restarted, no client-facing errors.

ana: fixed: reduced batcher.granule.max_size to 48 in canary and added a soft memory cap check; new rollout includes the cap.

sam: can you add a blurb to the release notes (console -> release feed) and tag eng-sre + devex? Also add a how-to in /docs/runtime/ops for fallback toggles.

ana: will do. Full roll to 100% planned in ~24h if no regressions; I'll post final summary then.

mike: flags for Dedicated/private deployments?

ana: opt-in for Dedicated for now (config: enable_granule_predictive=true) — want more scale datapoints before defaulting.

olivia: :tada: great work team — nice cost win.

mike: follow-ups: (1) add p95 by model in PR? (2) perf tests for mixed short/long sessions?

ana: yes to both — adding graphs and queuing mixed-session perf run.

deploy-bot: canary -> 10% complete, last health window OK

ana: thanks all — I'll post the 24h wrap with final numbers.

olivia: +1 — thanks for the clear notes :thumbsup:
